# PAYMENT-NOTICE

> Every page of the PAYMENT-NOTICE module of the ABDM Developer Portal, fetchable as markdown.

## Pages

- [Payment notice](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-119/docs/nhcx/v1/api/payment-notice): The Payment notice calls on NHCX: what each one does, the hosts they go to, and the guides that use them.
- [Provider: acknowledge the payment notice](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-119/docs/nhcx/v1/api/payment-notice/endpoints/payment-notice-v1-paymentnotice-on-request): Provider acknowledges a payment notice with a Task bundle (status completed, output paymentack), closing the payment lifecycle via NHCX.
- [Payer: send a payment notice](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-119/docs/nhcx/v1/api/payment-notice/endpoints/payment-notice-v1-paymentnotice-request): Payer pushes a Task bundle with PaymentNotice and PaymentReconciliation (amount, TDS, UTR) to the provider via NHCX after approving a claim.
- [Payer receives the payment acknowledgement](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-119/docs/nhcx/v1/api/payment-notice/endpoints/payment-notice-webhook-v1-paymentnotice-on-request): Hosted by the payer. The exchange posts this message to the endpoint_url you registered, at /v1/paymentnotice/on_request, with the headers and the sealed...
- [Provider receives a payment notice](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-119/docs/nhcx/v1/api/payment-notice/endpoints/payment-notice-webhook-v1-paymentnotice-request): Hosted by the provider. The exchange posts this message to the endpoint_url you registered, at /v1/paymentnotice/request, with the headers and the sealed...
- [Payment notice errors](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-119/docs/nhcx/v1/api/payment-notice/errors): What Payment notice returns when a call fails, and what to do about it.
